title: MNI Open iEEG Atlas: normal intracranial EEG in wakefulness and sleep (processed 200 Hz atlas clips)
description: Processed derivative release of the MNI Open iEEG Atlas, providing normal intracranial EEG (stereo-EEG and subdural strips/grids) from 106 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy. It includes one minute of artifact-free, 200 Hz bipolar-derivation signal per vigilance state (wakefulness, N2, N3, REM) and up to 10 minutes of N2/N3 sleep, restricted to channels judged to record normal activity. Channel locations are given in MNI152NLin2009aSym space, supporting normative mapping of intracranial activity across brain regions.
methods_description: Source recordings from three epilepsy centres were low-pass filtered at 80 Hz and resampled to 200 Hz, with power-line interference reduced in the 1-min set. Artifacts were visually rejected, and artifact-free segments were concatenated with zero buffers and padded to a common length. Data were converted losslessly to BrainVision float32 format, with bipolar channels and coordinates at contact midpoints.
